text:
maya: Quick sync — ACME contract goes live tomorrow and PM asked for per-customer toggle. need a safe partial enable + vip allowlist. who can confirm PR status?

sam: I reviewed the PR (#4821) this morning, left one minor nits comment on the gating logic. not blocking.

jen: I can pick it up after stand. is the plan: 5% tenant slice + explicit org allowlist for VIPs?

maya: correct. 5% random tenant slice for initial canary, then expand to contract-bound tenants, and VIP org ids (provided by AE) should be force-enabled regardless of slice.

leo: ok. important to ensure the flag evaluation order: contract check -> vip allowlist -> sample slice. otherwise VIPs could get sampled out.

ravi: agree. also want audit log entries when we toggle for contracted accounts. ops needs visibility.

maya: ops visibility is required. infra: can we get a per-flag event stream to datadog?

infra-bot: @maya created a ticket INF-267 to stream flag-eval events to datadog (sampled at 10%). link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-267

sam: below is the minimal config we landed on in the PR — modeled as JSON for the flag service. can we validate?

sam: ```json
{
  "flag_key": "acme_v2_feature",
  "mode": "contract_gated",
  "contract_allowlist": ["acme-contract-2026"],
  "vip_orgs": ["acme-enterprise-vip", "acme-exec"],
  "canary": {"type": "tenant_slice", "percent": 5},
  "audit": {"enabled": true, "sink": "datadog:flags"},
  "kill_switch": "/flags/kill/acme_v2_feature"
}
```

jen: looks good. only ask: make vip_orgs take org_id (not slug) — AE sent org_ids. also add a short-circuit so vip orgs bypass caching to ensure immediate effect when updating allowlist.

leo: for rollout ops we should also have a quick CLI to flip the customer-scoped override. propose this command:

leo: ```bash
# enable for an org id immediately
redwoodctl flags set --org 12345 --flag acme_v2_feature --value true --reason "VIP enable via AE"
```

ravi: +1. can infra add a perm check so only support/sre/product can run that?

ops-bot: permission policy updated: flag-override can be run by groups [support, sre, product].

maya: for telemetry — we'll attach a small eval test to smoke-check generation quality for contract tenants. ops: can you add a synthetic monitor that probes 3 sample contract tenants every 10m?

infra-bot: monitor ticket created: INF-268. monitor config: 3 tenants, 10m cadence, alert on error rate > 3% or latency > 600ms.

sam: PR action items: 1) address gating nits (i'll do), 2) switch vip_orgs to org_id, 3) add short-circuit cache bypass flag (optional config), 4) add integration test for kill-switch.

jen: i'll update the rollout playbook in ops-runbook: include verification steps, rollback steps (kill-switch command + how to remove contract allowlist), who to page.

ravi: what is the rollback kill-switch path? sam mentioned endpoint. need full command for runbook.

sam: kill switch is a POST to admin API. example:

sam: ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood.ai/flags/kill/acme_v2_feature
```

jen: adding that to runbook. also adding an immediate page target: #eng-oncall and #customer-success on page.

maya: timeline: get PR merged today, run canary (5%) for 24h, check metrics, then expand to contract-bound customers for next 12h, then full rollout. any objections?

leo: sounds fine. only ask we document exact metric dashboards to check: token error rate, tail latency p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens.

ravi: I'll wire up a small dashboard and share link here before EOD.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment queued: job 7865. will post status updates.

ops-bot: reminder: add ACME VIP org ids to secret store: secrets/flags/acme_vip_orgs (do not commit to repo).

maya: thanks all. i'll follow up with AE to confirm org_ids and add them to secrets. ping here when PR merged. :thumbsup:

sam: ping — PR merged 2547890150. starting canary rollout now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary job 7865 started at 2547890160.

ravi: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/flags/acme_v2_feature (has initial traffic)

jen: runbook updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/ACME+flag+rollout (includes kill-switch commands and paging matrix)

maya: perfect. leaving async check here. please post any anomalies in this thread.

leo: noted — will look at tracing if anything spikes.

ops-bot: If any error > 5% observed, automatic rollback policy will trigger after 3 consecutive checks.

maya: closing loop — thanks :rocket:
